import sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from te.session import _controller_route,_controller_admit
random.seed(8)
for mode,fn in [('route',_controller_route),('admit',_controller_admit)]:
 for Vmax in [1000,50000,100000,1000000,20000000]:
  worstst=0;worstcomp=0;worstsum=0;worsthc=0;bad=0
  for it in range(100000):
   E=random.randint(1,64);rho=random.choice([1,2,3,5,8]);vals=[random.uniform(-Vmax,Vmax) for _ in range(E)]
   z,t,h=fn(vals,list(range(E)),E,rho)
   ss=sum(t)
   for e in range(E):
    st=rho*(z[e]-vals[e])+t[e];worstst=max(worstst,abs(st))
    if abs(st)>1e-7:bad+=1
    comp=t[e]*(h-z[e]);worstcomp=max(worstcomp,abs(comp))
    if abs(comp)>1e-7:bad+=1
    if t[e]<-1e-12:bad+=1
   if mode=='route':
    if ss>1+1e-7:bad+=1
    hc=h*(1-ss);worsthc=max(worsthc,abs(hc))
    if abs(hc)>1e-7:bad+=1
  print(mode,Vmax,'worstst',worstst,'worstcomp',worstcomp,'worsthc',worsthc,'bad',bad)
